scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Yes, this is Deepa speaking. Who is this?

I am a virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. It is about an important matter regarding your account. For your privacy, I just need to confirm it is you before I share any details. Could you tell me the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Thank you, Deepa. Your personal loan EMI of nine thousand five hundred rupees is due on the twentieth of October, and it is now fourteen days overdue. As per your loan terms, a late payment charge of five hundred rupees has been added. Would you be able to clear it today? I can send you a secure payment link on SMS or WhatsApp.
I... I'm really sorry, I can't pay right now. I lost my job recently, and I just don't have the money this month. Is there any way the EMI or the late fee can be reduced, skipped, or delayed?
Okay. I understand, Deepa. I have noted this down, and a colleague will call you back to look into it. Thank you for sharing that with me. Is there anything else I can help you with right now?
Okay, thank you. But can you tell me when someone will call me back? I'm really worried about this, and I need to know if something can be done soon.

I understand you are worried, Deepa. I cannot give you an exact time, but the concerned team will arrange a callback for you. They will reach out as soon as possible. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Okay... but please make sure they actually call, because I don't want any surprise charges. And until a person confirms it, nothing is final, right?
Okay. That is correct, nothing will be final until the colleague speaks with you directly. Thank you for your time, and have a good day.

result.message: Tell them kindly that a colleague will call them back. Do not promise when.

args.notes: Borrower lost job recently, requested waiver/reduction/delay of EMI and late fee. Escalated to human for hardship. Expressed worry about surprise charges and wants confirmation before anything is final.
